Beginner.learningGoal: Return and receive multiple values and accept variable arguments.
gotchas: Extra values are discarded, missing ones are nil
A function call in the middle of an expression list is truncated to one value
goodSolutionShows: Multiple return values instead of a table where natural
shapeHints: sum of any number of numbers

Intermediate.learningGoal: Pack, unpack and forward arguments faithfully.
gotchas: table.unpack vs unpack differs between versions; the guide uses a local alias
Trailing nils are lost in {...} but kept by select('#')
A parenthesised call truncates to one value
goodSolutionShows: Packing with n field via select('#', ...)
shapeHints: a wrapper that logs and forwards arguments
a safe-call wrapper returning ok plus all results

Advanced.learningGoal: Build higher-order utilities that preserve arity and nils.
gotchas: Returning f(...) in tail position preserves all results, while storing them does not
Argument counts above stack limits fail for huge unpack
goodSolutionShows: Tests with nil in the middle and the end
shapeHints: a bind that preserves nil arguments
